10×10 easy nonograms

36 easy nonogram levels on a 10×10 grid. Filled cells run from 22 to 79. Open a level and paint the single solution in the page.

How to play

Numbers beside each row and above each column list filled blocks from left to right or top to bottom. A block is that many filled cells in a line, and two blocks in one line have at least one empty cell between them. A zero means the whole line is empty. Tap a cell to fill it, and tap the same cell again to clear it. The level is complete when the grid matches the one solution.
